extensions.title: Refine the existing agent-code go/no-go decision
additional_scope: Compare measured named tasks using the existing typed actions with one constrained-code candidate. Competitor parity or the availability of a code-execution SDK is insufficient justification.
Record input provenance, secret placement, package/filesystem access, network mediation, execution/resource budgets and pause/resume authority in the existing threat-model decision.

If Cloudflare Code Mode is evaluated, record its experimental status, exact SDK/runtime versions, supported execution profile and a replaceable executor interface. Reuse M16's qualified boundary where appropriate without making Cloudflare mandatory.

Explicitly compare stateless createCodeTool, which excludes approval-required tools, with the documented durable approval path. Decide whether the required workflow actually needs code and whether it can preserve exact server approvals.
Preserve the original human decision prerequisite and deferred/no-go outcome. Approving this research plan does not authorize arbitrary-code enablement or satisfy M12-G08's go decision.
additional_acceptance_criteria: The decision records a bounded task comparison and measurable unmet need, or concludes no-go/defer with code execution disabled.
The candidate architecture has no ambient merchant keys or generic egress and can preserve current approval, schema and operation/reconciliation authority.
A material change in required privileges, execution runtime or pause/replay behavior triggers review of the original decision before enablement.
extensions.targeted_fault: Enable code mode solely because it is on the roadmap or available in an SDK, without the recorded authorized go decision; the existing decision gate must reject it.
extensions.verification_policy: Use the current focused-development policy for local comparison and the existing human/independent decision gate. Preserve stable obligation IDs and do not require a full product regression merely to write the decision.
extensions.release_claim: A measured no-go or deferred decision is a valid decision outcome and never an implemented or qualified code-execution capability.
extensions.adoption_note: Additive future cross-reference only. The protected original goal object and its human/qualification prerequisites remain unchanged; no code execution is enabled.

extensions.title: Refine optional executor mediation, approvals and replay
additional_scope: Only after the original explicit go decision, connect a replaceable executor to the same typed broker/action gateway. Expose no raw adapters, database handles, merchant secrets or unbounded network/filesystem/package access.
Validate every requested operation and argument at the server regardless of SDK schema handling. The Code Mode resolver is not a substitute for Rifare's runtime validation or current task checks.
If using Dynamic Workers, explicitly deny general egress with globalOutbound:null or a separately verified egress policy; qualify the exact runtime instead of relying on raw loader defaults.

If approvals are needed, select and qualify the durable approval integration rather than assuming stateless createCodeTool can pause approval-required tools. Preserve exact preview/configuration/resource binding and current authorization at resume.

Treat SDK replay as execution control, not business idempotency. Do not mark financial or other irreversible calls replay:reexecute; preserve original operation identity and reconcile unknown effects.

Keep pausable work sequential unless the selected executor has demonstrated correct concurrent pause/replay semantics. A resumed task must retain its M16 restriction version and M15 authority ceiling where those profiles apply.
Qualify bounded time, memory, output and process behavior in the actual execution profile. Reuse the relevant M16 isolation evidence only when the executable runtime and trust boundary are the same.
additional_acceptance_criteria: A bounded deterministic transform can request one permitted typed action, while direct network, secret access, oversized output and unbounded execution are denied or terminated by the actual profile.
Malformed arguments and an unauthorized action fail at the server even if the executor or SDK accepts them; a paused approval resumes only for the still-valid exact preview.
A crash or approval pause after an ambiguous synthetic effect cannot cause a duplicate send on replay; the original operation remains unknown until authoritative reconciliation.
If no-go/deferred or any required boundary is unqualified, code mode remains disabled and the supported typed/manual workflow continues.
extensions.targeted_fault: Permit a raw adapter/secret inside the executor or reexecute an already attempted synthetic financial operation on resume; the focused isolation or replay fixture must reject the candidate.
extensions.verification_policy: Retain the existing stable tests and human/governance gate. Select only changed executor, authority and resume/reconciliation whole files for routine development; broaden for a specific uncovered risk or the required integrated acceptance gate.
extensions.release_claim: Optional code execution is conditional on the original go decision and actual executor qualification. Neither M15/M16 local readiness nor the availability of Cloudflare Code Mode establishes sandbox acceptance.
extensions.adoption_note: Additive future cross-reference only. The protected original goal object and its human/qualification prerequisites remain unchanged; no code execution is enabled.
